title: Mia's diary says she can read minds, then home tests during COVID

tellings.quote: diary and in her diary she said I can read my parents Minds she wrote in her diary that she can read everybody's mind

plain: A documentary filmmaker named Ky Dickens, who made The Telepathy Tapes, a series about non-speaking people said to read minds, tells the story of a girl named Mia in Monterrey, Mexico. Dickens says Mia wrote in her diary that she could read her parents' minds, and everybody's mind, and that a researcher named Diane Powell then tested her at home during the COVID years, around 2020 to 2022. If true, it would suggest that some minds can share thoughts directly.
